Artifact Adventure

Explore the ruins with three teammates, improve your Torch, and build a collection of valuable artifacts. Here’s how to manage Zobo encounters and work toward milestone rewards and better team records.

How to play

Form a team of four, collect Torches from the Pinball Machine, and explore for artifacts. Push deeper for rarer finds or retreat to protect your bag.
  1. Team up during enrollment. Enrollment takes place the day before the event. Invite three other trainers; remaining vacancies are filled by matchmaking when enrollment ends.
  2. Choose a Tatari and multiplier. Each advance spends Torches equal to the selected multiplier. Artifact value for the session scales by that multiplier.
  3. Advance through the ruins. Find artifacts, receive a buff, open a chest, or encounter a Zobo.
  4. Fight or retreat at a Zobo. Winning lets you collect its guarded artifact and continue. Losing ends the session and takes some artifacts from your bag. Retreating ends the session safely and refunds the Torches spent on that encounter.
  5. Claim personal milestones and improve your team codex. These are two different ways to earn rewards.

Use the event countdown for enrollment, exploration, and reward collection. Opening times can differ between event groups.

Torches & multipliers

The starting Torch grant is 50. During the event, the Pinball Machine supplies more Torches. Multipliers change the Torch cost and artifact value together; a higher multiplier does not itself promise rarer artifacts.

Torch upgrades improve the reward draw stage: draw stage = current adventure stage + (Torch level − 1) × 2. For example, a level 5 Torch at adventure stage 1 uses the stage 9 reward row. This changes reward draws, not your physical progress through the ruins.

TorchPersonal points milestoneReward draw offset
Lvl. 1 · TorchStarting level+0
Lvl. 2 · Pine Torch900,000+2
Lvl. 3 · Windproof Torch1,900,000+4
Lvl. 4 · Tactical Torch5,500,000+6
Lvl. 5 · Lambent Torch20,000,000+8

Claim the Torch Upgrade rewards at 900,000, 1,900,000, 5,500,000, and 20,000,000 personal points. The maximum Torch level is 5.

Exploration buffs

BuffEffect
Rule of ThreesYour next artifact find gives three copies.
Golden TouchYour next artifact find has S-grade value.
Divine ProtectionNo Zobo encounters for the next three advances; the encounter counter pauses during protection.

Rarity and value grade are different. Golden Touch guarantees the S value grade for the next artifact; it does not guarantee red rarity.

Zobos, support & retreat

These encounters use a chance check. Your Tatari’s combat strength does not determine the displayed win chance. Online teammates provide Friend Support up to level 3: +5, +8, or +10 percentage points.

ZoboNo supportSupport 1Support 2Support 3
Two-Headed Zobo90%95%98%100%
Goonch Zobo80%85%88%90%
Popstar Zobo70%75%78%80%
Roadhog Zobo55%60%63%65%
Tipsy Zobo50%55%58%60%
Clown Zobo45%50%53%55%
Sailor Zobo40%45%48%50%
Climber Zobo30%35%38%40%
Shaman Zobo25%30%33%35%
Pharaoh Zobo20%25%28%30%
The table shows the displayed encounter chances. A displayed chance below 100% still carries risk; check the encounter panel before choosing to fight.

Retreat protects the artifacts currently in your bag and refunds only the Torches used for the triggering encounter. It does not refund all Torches spent earlier in the session. A defeat ends the session and removes part of your bag.

When will a Zobo appear?

After an encounter, the advance counter resets. The first unprotected advance has no encounter. The next table separates the chance on an advance you actually reach from the share of encounters that occur at that count. Divine Protection pauses the counter.

Personal points & team codex

ProgressWhat it does
Personal pointsUnlock the 50 milestone rewards and Torch upgrades.
Team codexRecords your team’s highest-value finds for each artifact. The sum of codex artifact values determines ranking.

Finding another copy of an artifact is useful when it improves the value already recorded in the team codex. Team ranking is based on those best records, rather than simply adding every duplicate found by all four trainers.

Coordinate with your teammates so you can explore while they are online for Friend Support. Upgrade your Torch as soon as its milestone reward is available, and weigh the displayed fight chance against the artifacts you would risk losing.

Artifacts & value grades

There are 20 artifacts across blue, purple, gold, and red rarities. Within each rarity, artifacts also have D, C, B, A, and S value grades. The ranges below are base values before the session multiplier.

C · Basic30%40%
B · Uncommon30%40%

Personal milestone rewards

There are 50 personal milestones, ending at 40,000,000 points. Candy amounts are base amounts and can vary with stage-clear progress.

Total rewards

Select a milestone to see all rewards earned up to that row.

After the last milestone, the repeat reward is 1 Glitter Fruit per additional 500,000 points.
